sentences.text:
Author: Manoj Kumar Tiwari
Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari
Office Notes, reports, orders Sl. or proceedings Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No or directions and Registrar's order with Signatures Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J. None for the petitioner.
Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Brief Holder, for the State.

(2) Petitioner has sought quashing of FIR No. 0034 of 2021 lodged against him in PS Bazpur,
District Udham Singh Nagar, for the offence punishable under Section 420 IPC.
Allegation made against the petitioner is that he duped certain gullible persons by making false promises and cheated those gullible persons a substantial amount of money.
(3) Learned State Counsel submits that upon investigation, chargesheet has been filed against petitioner before the trial court by the investigating agency.
He thus submits that writ petition has become infructuous and petitioner can challenge the chargesheet in proceedings under Section 482 CrPC (now, Section 528 of BNSS), if so advised.

(4)
Merely because chargesheet is filed does not render the writ petition infructuous.

Writ petition for quashing the FIR has to be seen within the parameters laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. v. State of Maharashtra & others, reported in AIR 2021 SC 1918.

entities.text: Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. v. State of Maharashtra & others, reported in AIR 2021 SC 1918
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Since allegations made against the petitioner are specific and parameters laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the said case are not met, therefore, there is no scope for interference.
(5) Writ petition thus fails and is dismissed.

(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.) 12.11.2024 Pr WPCRL/265/2021 on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141281388/
